title: The Star Card in the Barn
lines: Dan and Dad park the car by the farm.
Dan starts to dig in the dark barn.
He finds a card in a dusty jar.
The card has a big gold star on it.
It is hard to spot in the dark barn.
Dan runs to the yard with the card.
Dad grins. That card was his as a kid.
Dad lets Dan hold it in the yard.

questions.ask: What did Dan find in the jar?
questions.listenFor: A card with a big gold star on it. Point back to the line if they guess.

questions.ask: Why did Dan run to the yard?
questions.listenFor: It was too dark in the barn to spot the star. The answer sits one line above.

questions.ask: How do you think Dad felt about the card? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The grin, or the card being his as a kid, both work.
